issues.body: The matrix promotes the minimal-N malicious equality and join cells to `BUILT (with-abort)` and the public API reports `AdversaryModel::Malicious`, while the same row states that external sign-off under `sq-qhy4` is pending. This is a cryptographic soundness claim, and the pending accredited-cryptographer review is an unresolved release gate rather than evidence that can be discharged by the in-process tests. The tests demonstrate selected tamper cases but cannot establish the claimed malicious-security theorem.
issues.fix_hint: Keep the capability status explicitly experimental/not-yet-audited and do not expose/report the production malicious tier until sq-qhy4 is complete, or hold this PR until that audit is available and its findings are incorporated. If the code lands as research scaffolding, use a descriptor/status that cannot be mistaken for an audited malicious-security guarantee.
issues.title: Soundness-critical capability is marked BUILT before the required external audit

issues.body: The public docs state a concrete `10^3-10^4 rows/holder` and `minutes` feasibility envelope. No canonical benchmark artifact is cited or updated by this diff, so these figures can become stale and are not reproducible evidence for this implementation.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the fixed row-count/time claims or replace them with a link to a generated canonical benchmark artifact; retain only the asymptotic cost and qualitative warning in the API docs.
issues.title: New API documentation hard-codes non-canonical performance limits

verdict.summary: The implementation and adversarial tests are carefully scoped, but this PR promotes the minimal-party equality/join cell to BUILT malicious-with-abort while the diff itself says the construction still awaits the external cryptographer review tracked by sq-qhy4. For this soundness-critical MPC surface, that unresolved audit gate prevents approval in this round. The new documentation also introduces fixed performance/envelope numbers that are not backed by a canonical benchmark artifact.
